speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have the look of a man who has been talked to by a tradesman. Sit. Threepence. What did the tradesman want, and what did he charge?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard Field, from the Blackfriars. He charged nothing today. Harrison will put Venus out again, smaller, a book for a pocket. There is not a penny in it for me. I told him I was glad to be thought portable.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Portable is a thing you carry. Like a pail. Is a poem a pail if it is small enough?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a book that fits a coat. I am not going to explain the press to a kitchen that has its own work. The news is the size. Small. More copies. Cheaper paper. Not mine to be paid for.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Cheaper paper is still paper. Did he sell you some, since you came down looking lighter and not looking poorer?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will lay by two quires of the Rochelle crown, at fourpence halfpenny the quire. I did not pay him. The paper is not in the house. When it is in my hand, the money can be in his. I will not pay an intention.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Fourpence halfpenny twice is ninepence. I can do that sum. I am not asking you to do it. I am showing off, and then I will stop.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Stop, then. Ninepence unpaid is not ninepence spent. Master Shakespeare, your letter is still folded. Tomorrow is the carrier. If Field has put a new boast into you, leave it out of the sheet. The sheet is already true.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sheet stays as it is. Thursday. I am not adding a pocket book to a letter about coming home. The day of coming is still not in it. Field asked after my father. I told him mending, which is all I have.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Mending again. I am tired of mending on your behalf. Tomorrow the bag will have a better word or a worse one, and I will carry the water up either way.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will carry the water because that is your place, not because the news deserves a procession. Eat. The loaf is a finger short. The meal is threepence. Venus can be famous in a pocket without my kitchen adding a chapter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence. A finger short. I am eating. He does not hold with the comedy. He wants to borrow the book when Garnish can spare it. An apprentice told him the Inns are talking. I said I would tell Garnish, and I said I would not send Field a yard.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Master Garnish and his pin. If he lends the book, does the pin go with it? I should not like to borrow a book that bites.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The pin stays with Garnish. The book is the book. Field can disapprove of it and still read it. That is a printer's privilege, and it is not a riddle.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Four young men swear off women and keep it till dinner. If he reads it, he will find them forsworn, and he will be right to frown, and I will not have the frown at this table a second time. I gave my opinion in the winter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Your opinion stands. I am not collecting it again with the soup. The third poem he asked for is not this comedy, and it is not written, and a Friday press can be idle without my help.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: What is a third poem if two are already books? Is it a child, or is it another pocket?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a poem I have not got. When I have it, he may print it. Until then his Fridays are his own, and my Wednesday is this table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: This table, and then your chamber, and no visitors on the stair unless they pay their own threepence, which they will not, because I am not feeding the Blackfriars. Mark me. Tomorrow you have a carrier and a play, and you will not do both in my hall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow the carrier is at the Bell after the play, not in your hall. The letter goes with me. It is still the Sunday sheet. I will not write Field into the margin to make myself interesting on the road.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will set it by your cloak in the morning so you do not go to the Keys without it and remember at the door. I have done that with handkerchiefs. A letter is only a heavier handkerchief.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Do it, and do not untie the fold to see if it has improved overnight. Folds do not improve. Men do, sometimes, and not by peeking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not peek. Portable, two quires not paid, mending until tomorrow, and threepence eaten. That is a Wednesday a man can stand upright in.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Upright, and still chewing. Gib has come off Ovid. He heard the word pocket and thought it was a lap. He is wrong, and he is heavy, and he is not getting the cheese.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The cheese is yours if you finish. The cat is nobody's debt. Master Shakespeare, I am glad your book is to be small. Small things get put back on shelves. I have a house full of large ones, and they rock.
